acceptance.artifact: strengthened validate_contracts.py plus divergence fixtures and tests
acceptance.assertion: For each of the three divergences — undeclared fields where the schema sets additionalProperties false, provider_state outside its enum, and result_transaction.state outside its enum — a document is exhibited that passes the current executable and violates the schema, then the executable is strengthened to reject it. All 23 seeded tests still pass and none of their assertions is weakened. Divergence is checked systematically against the schema rather than only for the three known cases.
acceptance.falsified_if: the executable and the schema still disagree on any admissible document, or a seeded assertion was weakened to make a fix look successful

hypothesis: The seeded executable validator is strictly weaker than the schema it implements, so a document can pass the gate that actually runs in clean runtimes while violating the documented contract.
